_comment: What the bot says after each of its unit turns. Keys are moods (beastborn/control/bot_voice.py: Mood). Add lines freely; a new mood needs a Mood value too.
start: Beep boop. I have calculated 5 turns ahead. You have calculated lunch.
Initiating Operation Big Rat. Resistance is mildly inconvenient.
Good luck, human. Statistically, you will need it.
attack: Your Boss's HP bar looks a bit long. Let me fix that.
I pruned that branch. And your unit.
defense: I'm not hiding, I'm optimising my position.
Waiting is also a move. A very clever move.
Patience is a virtue. Also a heuristic.
